description: Gen Digital Inc., with the purpose of Powering Digital Freedom and the mission of creating innovative and easy-to-use technology solutions that help people grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives, is a global leader in consumer Cyber Safety and Trust-Based Solutions, empowering people around the world to live safer digital lives while building confidence and control over their financial futures. Through its trusted brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock and MoneyLion, Gen helps people protect what matters most, and the acquisition of MoneyLion further expanded its go-to-market reach through a consumer and enterprise marketplace, branded Engine by Gen, where consumers can access a broad range of personalized and actionable offers for both financial and non-financial products and services, and its strategy is focused on delivering long-term sustainable and disciplined growth.
